column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 Kederon / Paua recruitment and departure
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Hey, it looks like someone is...
following us from behind!!
Who are you?! Show yourself already!
Y-you... I saw you in that village, did I not?!
I know I startled you, but I saw your fight with those $$医者$$s and followed because it caught my attention!
It looks like your journey...
has quite a story behind it!!
It's fine! You need not tell me every detail! Whatever appearances may say...
you are really a band of wanted...
and very vicious robbers, aren't you?!
I like it~!!
I can tell even if you try to hide it!
That muscle-bound gentleman there has the magnificent muscles of someone who could only have built them swinging a sword!!
He has the face of nothing but a bandit...
Nyaaah! Bandit, bandit~!
Heh heh heh...
A man's life should be short and bold!!
Every black-$$羽$$ man dreams at least once of being wanted...
of rampaging about exactly as he pleases!
Well? Why not take me into your party too?!
Let him join
Do not let him join
Now you're talking... My name is $$烈火のパウア$$!
Well then, now that I have joined your organization, even a white-$$羽$$ senior is a senior...
From now on, I will call you Muscle Big Bro!!
Heh heh heh...!
$$パウア$$ has joined the party!
Tch! I had planned to leave that village anyway...
I will find another path for myself!
Everyone... I am truly sorry for making you take this detour for me...
I am so sorry...!
No problem! Besides, your old man turned out to be...
more wicked than you, it seems!!
And somehow, compared with yesterday...
I think you have become even more handsome!!
Well, beside you... even a snake is a hundred times more handsome.
What did you say?!
Nyaaah, snake-snake frog! Frog-snake~!
More like a horse than a snake! A horse!!
Now, now. Once we cross this hill, $$ユダ$$ said we will finally reach the $$大邪神$$ armor...
the city of $$パンデモニウム$$.
From here onward, we must be all the more vigilant...
Say...
I think I understand, just a little, what that word you spoke of—$$愛$$—means...
Or at least, I feel like I do...
Father...
